summary: A companion can lower comprehension cost or simply create another system that must be understood and maintained.

points.text: A separate app introduces hosting, authorization, search, accessibility and lifecycle costs. Prefer the static-site floor until richer interaction pays for itself.
Large canvases and knowledge graphs can expose every relationship while clarifying none. Design around user questions and progressive disclosure, not maximum graph density.
Generated explanations may be fluent but wrong. Preserve source links, mark inference and uncertainty, and never let an unverified summary outrank executable artifacts.
The word companion can be confused with companion-model, while sidecar can be confused with sidecar-metadata. Naming must be reinforced by the product's comprehension purpose.
